NewsArticle.Title: Cthonic Remains
NewsArticle.Content: King Bruce of Loures Decreed: We urge Aislings with eighty or more insights to destroy the malignant horror that exists below the macabre house of Tagor. It is no doubt infused with centuries of evil that must be destroyed. May this Fall of Deoch 12 ((00.06.09)) be the Fall of the Macabre House of Tagor! King Bruce Court of Loures [Image of Loyal Loures Knight](http://www1.darkages.com/pics/s_cthonic.html) Hadrian is currently in exile from Loures for his questionably treasonous response. Hadrian, Suomi Dark Wizard, shakes his head at the history that King Bruce unfolded, or is repeating. He relates an awful book's passage that passed into his hands: The madman raved: In the depth something dark had been brewing for centuries. All the layers of history are not dead. They are buried but are not dead. The clerics who allied in the Shadow's War live. Their crusade, their burden, borne still. The worshippers of infernal beings. Twisted and malignant creatures, created out of the hate of the bowels of the earth. All nature twisted and horrible. That which dies does not die, but remains, decays, and returns in horror. [further in the book] The madman raved: One of the Six. One of the Six. The wisest and most powerful, no? He has the empire of below. Quoted from the centuries old, banned book, The House Macabre
